The '''droid marine''' was a variant of the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]] variant deployed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They specialized in boarding enemy ships.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Advance the attack!|A droid marine|<ref name="BFII" />}}
[[File:Droidmarine.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Droid marines had green markings on their armor.]]
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] marine was designed by [[Baktoid Combat Automata/Legends|Baktoid Combat Automata]] and saw combat against the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Bearing [[Color/Legends|green]] markings on their skeletal forms, droid marines were equipped with a standard [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]], [[E-60R missile launcher]], and supplied with four [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]]. They also wore a backpack like object with them, much like other B1 counterparts. They had the ability to pilot ships, but their primary function was to either defend their [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], or board an enemy ship. They were almost never seen on the ground.<ref name="BFII" />

==History==
[[File:BF_Mustafar_Hangar.jpg|thumb|230px|right|Droid marines boarding an Imperial Star Destroyer during the Battle of Mustafar.]]
Serving as a Separatist capital ship's last line of defense against [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone]] boarders, they were also useful for boarding the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic's]] [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] and destroying them from within. They penetrate the inner workings of a Republic vessel and blow up the shield generator, letting a CIS cruiser destroy the star destroyer. Droid marines almost proved themselves as worthy opponents for the [[Clone marine]]s and Pilots of the Clone Army. They could board by landing in the hangar of an enemy cruiser.
After the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|execution]] of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], these units were de-activated. However, some would be used by the separatist fugitive [[Gizor Dellso]] in the [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|Battle of Mustafar]].<ref name="BFII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The droid marine was created for ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]],'' in that game they are the only B1 variant that uses the E-5 blaster rifle. As with the marine units of the other factions, they are only present in space battles.<ref name="BFII" />
